subject: Error in running the bcfa function

messages.author: 01b216d7e6cc0000
messages.subject: Error in running the bcfa function
parts:
Dear blavaan users,
after loading the blavaan package and upgrading lavaan to the latest version (0.5-20), I run the first bcfa function reported in the Merkle and Rosseel's paper on blavaan and I got the following error message:

> model <- ' visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3 '
> fit <- bcfa(model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939, jagfile = TRUE)

Failed with error: ‘there is no package called ‘modeest’’
Error in floor(num.version): 
non-numeric argument to mathematical function
In addition: Warning message:
In findjags() :
JAGS was not found in the common install locations on your system; please provide a path to the executable as the jags argument or using runjags.options()
Error in blavaan(model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939, jagfile = TRUE,  : 
blavaan ERROR: problem with jags estimation.  The jags model and data have been exported.    

I was using R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31).

Thank you very much for any assistance.

Best regards,
Gian Mauro Manzoni

messages.subject: Re: Error in running the bcfa function
parts:
Dear blavaan users,
I installed JAGS on my system and the bcfa function worked but only after deleting the convergence argument. 

> bfit <- bcfa(model, data = st, convergence = "auto")
Error in lavaan("ability =~ abstract + verbal + numerical", data = list( : 
  unused argument (convergence = "auto")

If the argument is "unused", why does the iteration and computation process stop?

Thank you very much in advance for any advice.
